content: MCP transport: stdio is single-threaded, no multiplexing, cannot connect from independently-spawned processes. HTTP+SSE deprecated March 2025. Use Streamable HTTP for embedded server. MCP client default idle timeout 60s (DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MSEC). Long tools must emit progress notifications every 10-15s to reset idle timer. CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT env var disables timeout. New server instance per HTTP connection required — sharing causes response misrouting.
